feed.title: Tech News - Latest Technology and Gadget News | Sky News

articles.title: Jensen Huang says he'd be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Jensen Huang has acknowledged "serious mistakes" in his first statement since resigning as CEO of Nvidia, but says he would be honoured to return to his role.

articles.title: Nvidia creates national security committee after CEO's abrupt exit over alleged affairs
articles.summary: Nvidia has established a new national security committee after its CEO resigned amid accusations of affairs with two employees and an alleged Chinese spy.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue bots' 'dangerous' attack on another AI company
articles.summary: California attorney general Rob Bonta has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing the tech giant of endangering public safety by creating AI models without adequate "safeguards".

articles.title: US to further curb China's access to Nvidia chips
articles.summary: The US government is set to further restrict China's access to the most powerful AI chips, such as the ones provided by tech giant Nvidia.

articles.title: AI child sex abuse images 'soar 8,400% in two years'
articles.summary: The amount of child sex abuse images and videos generated using AI is 85 times higher than just two years ago, scientists discovered.

articles.title: FBI seizes $1.2bn stolen in Binance cryptocurrency hack
articles.summary: The FBI has seized more than $1.2bn (£910m) of cryptocurrency stolen from Binance last month.

articles.title: Storms hitting UK at same time led to one of country's wettest days on record
articles.summary: Storms Austen and Boelo striking different parts of the UK at the same time contributed to 24 October being one of the wettest days Britain has ever seen.
